reason: I already cook kra pao and green curry without looking, and when I want something new I watch a free clip in bed. Paying 99 baht, two plates of food, to learn dishes I can see for free doesn't make sense for me.
objection: I don't lack recipes, I lack time and space. After work a 50-baht plate from the stall is faster than cooking for the family in my tiny kitchen with one pan, and an app can't give me more time.
would_change_my_mind: If I could try one Sunday plan for free and it really fed my family for less than street food, using only my one pan, I would pay the 99.
